purpose: 读取全部原企业家PDF全文及本季当前周转数值、原方法/工业母体、元日期与原显示公开钟。自动失败不猜数、不删季度，金融前保存。
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,re,pdfplumber
ROOT=Path.cwd();R='reports/research/510300_enterprise_working_capital_source_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save_new(name,obj):
 p=OUT/name;assert not p.exists(),'原输出不覆盖：'+name
 p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
acq=json.loads((OUT/'全部29企业家原发布钟与附件.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert acq['successes']==29
rows=[];full=[]
for t in acq['targets']:
 q=t['quarter'];p=ROOT/t['pdf_receipt']['path'];assert sha(p)==t['pdf_receipt']['sha256']
 with pdfplumber.open(p) as pdf:
  pages=[{'pdf_page_1based':i+1,'full_text':page.extract_text() or ''} for i,page in enumerate(pdf.pages)]
  meta={str(k):str(v) for k,v in pdf.metadata.items()}
 body='\n'.join(z['full_text'] for z in pages);norm=re.sub(r'\s+','',body).replace('％','%')
 title=f"{q[:4]}年第"+{'1':'一','2':'二','3':'三','4':'四'}[q[-1]]+'季度企业家问卷调查报告'
 front=re.sub(r'\s+','',pages[0]['full_text']);title_ok=title in front
 values=re.findall(r'资金周转指数为([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)%',norm)
 named_value=float(values[0]) if len(values)==1 and 0<=float(values[0])<=100 else None
 method_match=re.search(r'(?:7[、.]|资金周转指数[：:])[^。]*资金周转[^。]*。.*?(?=8[、.]|销货款回笼指数[：:])',norm,re.S)
 if not method_match:
  start=norm.rfind('资金周转指数：');end=norm.find('8、',start) if start>=0 else -1
  method=norm[start:end] if start>=0 and end>start else ''
 else:method=method_match.group(0)
 method_ok=all(x in method for x in ['本企业','本季','良好','一般','权重','0.5'])
 population=[z for z in pages if '调查对象' in z['full_text']]
 population_text='\n'.join(z['full_text'] for z in population)
 popnorm=re.sub(r'\s+','',population_text)
 population_ok=all(x in popnorm for x in ['5000','工业企业','除西藏'])
 metadates=[]
 for k in ['CreationDate','ModDate']:
  m=re.match(r'D:(\d{8})',meta.get(k,''))
  if m:metadates.append({'field':k,'raw':meta[k],'calendar_date':m.group(1)[:4]+'-'+m.group(1)[4:6]+'-'+m.group(1)[6:]})
 release_date=t['original_pubdate_meta'];later=[z for z in metadates if z['calendar_date']>release_date]
 qualified=title_ok and named_value is not None and method_ok and population_ok and len(metadates)>=1 and not later
 rows.append({'quarter':q,'original_article_title':t['original_article_title'],'pdf':t['pdf_receipt'],'release':t['release_receipt'],'original_publication_display':t['original_display_release_clock'],'page_createDate_not_historical_clock':t['page_createDate_not_historical_clock'],
 'target_field':'资金周转指数','unit':'百分比','current_value_percent':named_value,'raw_named_current_value_candidates':values,
 'current_requested_title_in_original_front':title_ok,'automatic_current_value_and_method_qualified':qualified,'current_original_method':method,'current_original_method_qualified':method_ok,'original_population_pages':population,
 'original_industrial_population_qualified':population_ok,'original_pdf_metadata':meta,'original_pdf_metadata_dates':metadates,'known_later_file_than_displayed_original_release':bool(later),'known_later_metadata':later,
 'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'response_collection_start':'UNKNOWN','response_collection_end':'UNKNOWN'})
 full.append({'quarter':q,'pdf':t['pdf_receipt'],'all_original_pages_full_text':pages})
 if len(rows)%5==0:print('已读完整原企业家报告：'+str(len(rows))+'/29',flush=True)
save_new('全部29企业家原全文与当前周转字段_自动原输出.json',{'completed_at':now(),'targets':rows,'all_original_pages_full_text':full,'new_equity_labels':0,'new_model_fits':0,'new_accounts':0})
save_new('原读取环境探针说明.json',{'recorded_at':now(),'first_probes':[{'module':'fitz','status':'ModuleNotFoundError_before_PDF_read'},{'module':'pypdf','status':'ModuleNotFoundError_before_PDF_read'}],'actual_available_reader':'pdfplumber','dependency_installs':0,'PDF_originals_edited':False,'numeric_fields_from_failed_imports':0,'new_model_fits':0,'new_network_retries':0})
print(json.dumps({'全部完整原报告':len(rows),'自动字段与原方法/母体/钟通过':sum(z['automatic_current_value_and_method_qualified'] for z in rows),'原当前值':[{'quarter':z['quarter'],'value':z['current_value_percent'],'source_ok':z['automatic_current_value_and_method_qualified']} for z in rows],'未通过细节':[{'quarter':z['quarter'],'title':z['current_requested_title_in_original_front'],'raw_candidates':z['raw_named_current_value_candidates'],'method':z['current_original_method_qualified'],'method_text':z['current_original_method'],'population':z['original_industrial_population_qualified'],'known_later_metadata':z['known_later_metadata']} for z in rows if not z['automatic_current_value_and_method_qualified']]},ensure_ascii=False))
